9287f7ca: ;
 ;Initialize variables for DGJTUDIS routine
 ;Get node 0 from file 393 for entry IFN
 ;Get parent entry for the movement record
 ;Construct patient data using parent admission movement record
3971cbba: ;If the parent admission movement record is not found, set DGJTPAR to null string
75b6f265: Get the value of the DT node for this patient and save it as DGJTNODT.
c1dfe959: Get the current system date and time and save the FileMan internal date value in DGJTNOW.
514bf937: If the status of the record matches the incomplete status, process the record.

830eb231: If the status is incomplete, check if the record has expired and perform necessary calculations. Set DGJTFLAG to 1 if the record has expired or if the current date is equal to the admission date month and year. Calculate the number of days the record has been incomplete and save it in DGJTDL if the record has expired. Call the DAYS subroutine if the record has expired.
7fd11e82: Check if the record is a Clinical Dictation record, set DGJTFLAG if so, and call DAYS^DGJTU.
34ccf893: Check if the record is a Transcribed record. If so and the transcribed date is not too old, set DGJTFLAG and call DAYS^DGJTU.
f7bc5aff: If the record has a deletion date, and it is a Signed record, and the signed date is not too old, set DGJTFLAG and call DAYS^DGJTU.
86a1b6cf: ;Quit if the entry date/time is not defined
7729c9c8: ;Convert entry date/time to days since system startup date
